song: 01 - Kybba, Ryan Castro, Sean Paul & Busy Signal - BA BA BAD REMIX (Video Oficial)
title: the dancehall signal tears on the dembow snare
story: BA BA BAD opens on a thin intro (rms 0.09) whose half-bar hits rise into a build from tick 211 and drop at 329 (onset 19.5, +2 sd). The torn TV signal in dancehall-flag (green, gold, black, red) starts dim under heavy scanlines and tears on each intro hit, a little harder every time, until the drop flashes, shakes and swings the hue. Then the dembow plays the screen: the snare on 16ths 4, 7, 12, 15 tears the rows with an RGB split, the kick on 1 and 9 (the only kicks the onsets show) punches zoom and brightness, and every two beats the palette's hue and contrast step. The beat cuts out at 597 to a grey dead signal, the 27.5 slam at 628 tears everything, a rolling bar rocks the hue with growing shakes, and the dembow settles back in as a loop.
